children: Uniswap, PancakeSwap, Aero, Pump, and BisonFi ranked as the five largest DEX protocols by trading volume over the past seven days. According to Foresight News, citing DefiLlama data, Uniswap recorded about $13.079 billion in volume, followed by PancakeSwap at $5.892 billion, Aero at $3.538 billion, Pump at $1.938 billion, and Solana-based Prop AMM BisonFi at $1.862 billion. Aero Slipstream, launched on October 22 through the merger of Aerodrome and Velodrome, recorded about $868 million in trading volume.

title: Uniswap, PancakeSwap, Aero, Pump, and BisonFi Rank Among Top Five DEXs by 7-Day Volume
